market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76K on April 30, 2026 needs to drop ~41% to $45,000 within 8 months to resolve YES. Bitcoin's annualized volatility is ~50-70%, so an 8-month low of $45K corresponds roughly to a 1.5-sigma down move. Recent range has been $74-79K with strong ETF support; no clear bearish catalyst dominating. Base-rate probability of a >40% drawdown over 8 months from current spot is around 20-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Geopolitical/macro shock or risk-off event could accelerate selling beyond historical base rates.
